headline: Liquor license requests and police reports involving Broadway and Lawrence Street businesses.
summary: Four license requests are on the agenda, including a tabled liquor license transfer and a one-day all alcohol license. Two police reports cover incidents at Guld Louge and Mamacitas Nightclub.
items: California Restaurant Inc., DBA Attika Restaurant, at 1 Mill St. (LL26-000041): change of manager, officers or directors, stock transfer or new stockholder, and DBA name
Police report #26006508: October 4, 2026 incident at Guld Louge, 271 Broadway, citing underage drinking, severe overcrowding, and several other concerns; Cpt. Montas and Officer Cruz to present
Tabled from 9/23/2026: Father & Son, DBA Envy Lounge, transfer of liquor license to Kathan LLC, DBA Rumba Bar & Lounge (LL26-000039)
Panaderia El Chapin: common VIC license at 261-265 Broadway (VIC26-000040)
Limonences Unidos en el Exterior: one-day all alcohol license at 272 Broadway (LL26-000040)
Incident report #26005813: September 6, 2026 underage drinking, improper ID checks, operating hours violation, and security concerns at Mamacitas Nightclub, 206 Lawrence St.
location: City Council Chambers, Room 105, City Hall, 200 Common St., Lawrence, MA 01840
